scope.method: Read stored artifacts only; recompute prompts, joins, hashes, costs and metrics from raw records where possible.

checks.title: Six complete runs, 1,080 records
checks.detail: Six runs x 180 = 1,080 records, all ok, no partial run.

checks.title: Forward/reverse maps exact, 90/90
checks.detail: Forward maps equal the pair_joint base; reverse maps are exact complements; 90/90.

checks.title: DA reproduces per condition
checks.detail: DA reproduces per condition, analysis JSON, summary and report.

checks.title: Exchange consistency reproduces
checks.detail: Exchange-consistency DA, semantic agreement, same-letter rate and the 74.44% / 72.22% length baselines all reproduce.

checks.title: Prompts are metadata/slot-free
checks.detail: All 1,080 prompts are metadata/slot-free outside code; only the documented CVE-2017-17969 comment remains in one pair's body.

checks.title: Cache/checkpoint and resume are consistent
checks.detail: 1,080 stored records = 1,029 newly issued requests + 51 cached responses from test_mimo_open_rev; cache keys equal request fingerprints and README/report both state the split (129 newly issued requests for the resumed run).

checks.title: Manifests, hashes and credentials are clean
checks.detail: Six manifests complete/unpartial; dataset hash frozen; keys never stored; Authorization omitted.

checks.title: Four arms complete at 60/60/58/58
checks.detail: Arms complete at 60/60/58/58 planned records; verifier-invalid records are 0/2/1/0 and are handled fail-closed.

checks.title: First-pass metrics reproduce
checks.detail: First-pass metrics reproduce (DeepSeek 159 valid + 1 invalid, MiMo 158 + 2).

checks.title: Fail-closed post metrics reproduce
checks.detail: Fail-closed post metrics and retraction precision reproduce; negatives and pre-invalid rows are untouched.

checks.title: Exact McNemar reproduces
checks.detail: Exact McNemar pre-vs-post reproduces for all four arms.

checks.title: Prompts rebuild and stay label-free
checks.detail: All 236 verifier prompts rebuild byte-identically; wrapper has no label/project/path field.

checks.title: Cache has no hits or cross-arm reuse
checks.detail: All 236 records have their own cache entry, zero hits and no cross-arm key reuse.

checks.title: Verifier cost recomputes
checks.detail: Verifier cost totals $0.154333.

checks.title: Post-hoc status is disclosed
checks.detail: Exploratory/post-hoc status and fail-closed/fail-open policies are explicit.

checks.title: Test140 units and labels match the freeze
checks.detail: 140 frozen test units, 70/70, exactly matching juliet/subset_units.jsonl.

checks.title: Confusion is 70/0/70/0
checks.detail: 70 TP / 0 FP / 70 TN / 0 FN; coverage 1.000 and no undecided unit.

checks.title: Per-mode evidence and 12 new units are exact
checks.detail: Mode counts 58/7/63; the 12 newly observable units are exactly 7 realloc-fail + 5 no-global and attribute to their own sources.

checks.title: No failures or undecided units
checks.detail: No compile failure, timeout or undecided unit; verify.json and the build/run checks are clean (the failure map only contains leak/clean decisions).

checks.title: Default mode reproduces old ASan
checks.detail: Default mode agrees with the frozen old ASan run 140/140; old observable bad units remain 58/70.

checks.title: No API/model usage
checks.detail: Local tool run: no network/API client import and no model field in the results.

checks.title: README ceiling claims match rows
checks.detail: README ceiling 70/0/70/0, 12/12 new evidence and 0/70 good FPs match the rows.

checks.title: Two complete 140-unit runs
checks.detail: Two complete 140-unit runs, all ok/valid, zero API errors (280 requests).

checks.title: HDE accuracy reproduces
checks.detail: HDE confusion and accuracy reproduce (DeepSeek 137/140, MiMo 136/140).

checks.title: Paired McNemar contrasts reproduce
checks.detail: Paired counts, exact p-values and deltas reproduce for all four baselines.

checks.title: Prompts rebuild and stay sanitized
checks.detail: All 280 guided prompts rebuild byte-identically (140 unique); direct equals hybrid v2; evidence blocks are label/path/CWE-free.

checks.title: Evidence matches the dynamic modes
checks.detail: Enhanced evidence matches the dynamic mode decisions, has 13 distinct texts and covers the 12 new units.

checks.title: 280-request cost and smoke split
checks.detail: 280 requests cost $0.023561; two smoke calls add $0.000087716 (all-in $0.023648).

checks.title: Frozen v2 baselines are read-only
checks.detail: Frozen v2 baselines predate the new run; the v2 input pack hash still matches 1ec51f57...

checks.title: Copying caveat and flips reproduce
checks.detail: Tool agreement and flips vs v2 direct reproduce; the report refuses a semantic-reasoning claim.

checks.title: 200 units/splits/labels match the freeze
checks.detail: 200 unique frozen units (100/100; test 140 / dev 60); input hash matches the Juliet freeze.

checks.title: 194 ok / 6 compile_error, all documented
checks.detail: 194 ok / 6 compile_error; all six are _82 (4 test, 2 dev); no timeout or tool error.

checks.title: Per-query counts and 132 diagnostics
checks.detail: Per-query counts reproduce; 132 raw diagnostics, all in target files.

checks.title: Output hashes and raw artifacts intact
checks.detail: Manifest output hashes match; 194 SARIF files and 6 compile-error stderr logs are present.

checks.title: Clang/Cppcheck comparison; F1 caveat
checks.detail: Baselines and coverage gains reproduce (15 Clang-missed bad units recovered, no Clang positive missed, all 23 FP are C++). static_extended/README.md now labels both positive-class F1(V) (0.8447 vs Clang 0.8618) and Macro-F1 (0.8173 vs 0.8768), names Macro-F1 as the project primary endpoint and states the two are not interchangeable.

checks.title: No API use and no Juliet modification
checks.detail: Local CodeQL run; the Juliet subset hash is unchanged and no model/API field is present.

checks.title: Limitations are disclosed
checks.detail: README documents single-TU databases, compiler differences, compile errors and tools not run.

checks.title: 12 old runs are hash-identical
checks.detail: All 12 legacy result/config/metrics hashes match; 36 hashes verified, no old run rewritten.

checks.title: 102 invalid split 93 + 9
checks.detail: 102 invalid split exactly into 93 missing-explanation (stop, fixed_function present) and 9 truncations (length, unparseable).

checks.title: Invalid costs recompute; price basis flagged
checks.detail: Both schema cost bases are present and reconcile exactly with analysis/cost_normalization.json: configured-peak cache-aware $2.521790096 (4,968 records) = legacy_test.configured_cache_aware_usd; off-peak list $1.572472286 = legacy_test.normalized_list_usd, delta $0 on both. The 102 invalid records also recompute at $0.218280 (peak) and $0.109140 (off-peak); README states the two bases and the 10.32% / 9.61% invalid shares.

checks.title: MiMo 61/61 field drift reproduces
checks.detail: 61/61 drift remappable; 5 true / 56 false; 28/61 label agreement; 60+1 alias split with one both-key record.

checks.title: Zero API/network calls
checks.detail: Read-only replay: no network import and api_calls=0 in scope and sources.

checks.title: L0/non-accuracy caveats present
checks.detail: README states L0 (no compile/test/PoC), separates official/code-only and treats truncation as fatal.

checks.title: README rates match the JSON
checks.detail: All headline schema rates/denominators match the JSON and 924/102/93/9 counts.

checks.title: Latest literature files and index exist
checks.detail: Three research/latest_*.md files and docs/LITERATURE.md exist and are non-trivial.

checks.title: Reference sections and schema citations resolve
checks.detail: Reference sections exist and every schema_recovery letter-numbered citation resolves in latest_llm_methods.

checks.title: Snapshots are stale on the new experiments
checks.detail: Both research/latest_*.md files carry the 2026-11-14 dated status note. It scopes the original 2026-11-13 text as writing-time, lists schema recovery, pair_debias, evidence_verify, dynamic_enhanced, hybrid_dynamic_enhanced and CodeQL as completed, and says the historical body is intentionally unchanged (so the old '未实现' lines are explicitly historical, not current claims).

checks.title: Index maps the new groups
checks.detail: docs/LITERATURE.md maps all six new result groups to their literature basis and limitations.

checks.title: Legacy results predate all new experiments
checks.detail: Newest legacy artifact audit/final_audit.md at 2026-11-11T21:58:24.203676+00:00 predates the first new run; final_audit.* untouched.

checks.title: Frozen inputs and legacy hashes unchanged
checks.detail: Frozen Juliet, both splits, the hybrid v2 pack and all 12 legacy result files still match their recorded hashes.

checks.title: New artifacts contain no credentials
checks.detail: Scanned 5404 text artifacts in the six new directories; no credential-like string found.

checks.title: Only the two latest_audit files are written
checks.detail: Only audit/latest_audit.json and audit/latest_audit.md are written; final_audit.* is untouched.

checks.title: Audit itself is offline
checks.detail: The audit script is offline; it only reads stored artifacts.
